label: Send an email campaign to your test list
description: Send a test version of an email campaign to specified email addresses or your entire test list. If the emailTo array is left empty, the test mail will be sent to all addresses in your test list. You can send a maximum of 50 test emails per day.

emailTo.description: List of the email addresses of the recipients whom you wish to send the test mail. _If left empty, the test mail will be sent to your entire test list. You can not send more than 50 test emails per day_.

ui_steps: Send the test to your own address

preconditions: A verified phone number on the account
